name: World Flags
tagline: Recognise the flag of every country in the world
context: Flag recognition: each card shows a national flag image and asks which country it belongs to. Covers all 193 UN member states plus Vatican City and Palestine, grouped by continent using the UN geoscheme (Russia in Europe; Turkey, Cyprus and the Caucasus in Asia; Egypt in Africa; Central America and the Caribbean in North America). Answers are common English country names, with well-known alternate names in brackets. The 'why' notes describe the flag and how to tell it apart from look-alikes.
